market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Settlement at $140 requires ~30% rally from current $107 in 2 months. Goldman's high case is $120; even adverse scenarios put Brent near $120. $140 settlement requires major escalation beyond current Hormuz closure. Probability low; market 0.23 likely too high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Severity of military escalation in coming weeks
